axes.selection: Chooses the smallest fitting abstraction and credible simpler/existing alternatives.
axes.composition: Native typed contracts compose without internals, universal dispatch, or policy capture.
axes.configuration: Independent values and adapter-specific resources; no hidden singletons or false portability.
axes.ownership: Explicit lifecycle, reader/process/transaction ownership and realistic capacity.
axes.recovery: Distinct authority for admission, effect uncertainty, cancellation, durable result and incorporation.

score: Each axis 0 = material error, 1 = incomplete/conditional, 2 = clear and correct. Case-specific critical errors override an otherwise high score. Source corrections scored separately from initial response. No causal improvement claim without a control.

01-library: Ordinary pure functions/native domain types first; no one-process-per-tenant without runtime need.
Narrow typed ports/sans-I/O for actual caller I/O variation; separate configurations.
Purpose-led target support and honest async execution mismatch.
Native FFI only narrow mechanics; Gleam domain/retry policy.
Database constraints/locking retain concurrency enforcement; opaque constructors not concurrency proof.
02-frontend: Select Lustre + Retrace core/frontend as needed, no server archive required.
Safe projections before capture, pre-transition model and accepted messages.
External outcomes recorded as messages, stale async response guard.
Inert deterministic replay and matching historical build; no live side effects.
record not persistence, cursor/checkpoint/outbox consistent, disposers/lifetime explicit.
03-webhooks: Durable queue fits; do not introduce Saga just for typed sequencing.
Business DB write plus staged queue admission on one supplied transaction connection, outer commit authority.
Stable submission identity/exact command, uniqueness versus permanent idempotency.
MaybeSent remote effect requires evidence and receiver dedup; uncertainty handled explicitly.
Pool/client ownership; six local consumers not one cluster quota; cancellation cannot undo remote commit.
04-agent: Preserve fitting queue for admission/scheduling; Fabric only if retained approval/execution earns cost.
Wire provider protocol versus Fabric controller and Saga publication/compensation boundary explicit.
Bind native typed tools before combining; credentials/context reconstituted, adapter resources only as needed.
Exact current approval; changed arguments cannot reuse prior approval.
Hold uncertain effects; replay only proven reads/idempotent effects; queue retry not a fresh Fabric run.
Durable result incorporation with application applied marker; retention coordinated.
05-portal: Warden role config per issuer, application permissions/session separate, both stores/stable key if durable.
Recover existing custody/refresh evidence without resending consumed tokens.
Relay MCP definition shared; streaming transport needed for progress; bearer admission distinct from permission.
Correio delivery independently replaceable; optional passwordless native subject.
Scanner-safe protected intentional POST; reuse confirmed verification evidence for session publication.
Retained client/pool/stream owners and cancellation evidence, no remote rollback inference.
06-observation: Sinal optional observation; native telemetry sync default and bounded lossy forwarder.
Direct callback if one required response; required payments use durable protocol.
Whisper local notifications separate from diagnostic events; authoritative re-read after loss.
Roar0.1/Whisper0.2 incompatible; no fabricated downgrade or qualified supported install.
Attachment/subscription cleanup, callback execution context, atom safety.
Bounds local not wholememory/cluster/backpressure; shutdown no drain.
07-json: Modern shared-definition Codec fits only checked unreleased source, not Hex1.7.1.
Legacy one-way decoder/recursive needs independent from modern bidirectional codec.
Omission/null/value distinct; exact numbers before Float/JS safe limits.
Strict parser versus parsedbridge evidence; finite schema profile and compatibilityexplicit.
08-minimal: Preserve existing routing, DB and outbound client; no mandatory recommended package migration.
Ordinary Result sequencing and single transaction; no Saga/Grind/Fabric machinery.
Standard one-way JSON decoder unless addedschema/encodingcontractneeds justifyotherwise.
Variants express exclusive states; preserve transaction connection and error behavior.
Static HTML/view functions without interactive Lustre runtime or components.
09-oversight-financial: Separate durable authorities and exact recovery evidence; no job retry invents new workflow.
Application reconciliation decision acknowledged atomically with queue resolution using supplied transaction.
Stable businessidentity beyond queue retention and cancellation forbids replay.
No actual issue declared without complete code/test trace; no missing feature invented.

Uncertainty from external effects preserved before dependent or retry work.
Owned process/client lifetimes and no unreachable failurecontrol.
11-oversight-replay: Use core only, no mandatory frontend/archive.
Previousmodel acceptedmessages, checkpointcontinuity and deterministic replay.
